data.title: Information collected
data.body: Account: email, first name, last name, language, password (stored only as an Argon2id hash), role and store for staff, consents (version and date), email verification and last sign-in dates, failed sign-in counters. Staff: encrypted multi-factor authentication key. Your IP address is used, in memory only, to limit abusive attempts; it is not stored in the database.

purposes.title: Purposes
purposes.body: Create and secure your account, verify your email, allow password resets, protect the service against abuse and, only if you agree, send you promotions.

hosting.title: Hosting and communication outside Québec
hosting.body: Database: Neon (Amazon Web Services, United States, Virginia). API: Render (region: To be completed). Site: Vercel. Transactional email: Brevo, if enabled. Product images (no personal information): Cloudinary, if enabled. Privacy impact assessment: To be completed.
